data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a mixed prior year development in 2023, with an overall gross back year release of GBP 20.4m for the 2021 closed year of account. This was primarily driven by favourable claims development and IBNR recalibrations across long-tail casualty, short-tail, and auto accounts for 2019 and 2020 years, as well as a reduction in the gross ultimate provision for Covid-19. However, this was partially offset by deterioration in 2020 wind events (Hurricane Laura, Hurricane Sally, and Derecho). Favourable litigation trends also contributed to the positive development.

data.data_quality_notes: The overall gross prior year development figure of GBP 20.4m is explicitly stated as a 'gross back year release' for the 2021 closed year of account. However, the sum of individually quantified gross LOB movements (long-tail casualty, short-tail, auto, 2020 wind events, Covid-19) results in a different aggregate gross movement (-GBP 17.623m). This discrepancy suggests the GBP 20.4m might be a net effect of various gross movements, or that not all components were explicitly quantified or captured.
